guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：天文自適應光學
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Astronomical adaptive optics
guides.concept: 以 ESO VLT 自適應光學設施（1170 致動器的變形副鏡）與 ELT 的 2.4 m、5000 餘致動器 M4 為範本：從 r0、Greenwood 頻率與等暈角推出變形鏡與波前感測器的規格，再把擬合、時間延遲、量測雜訊與非共光路像差整合成 Strehl 預算，最後以即時控制迴路與天上驗證完成工程交接。
guides.conceptEn: Using the ESO VLT Adaptive Optics Facility with its 1170-actuator deformable secondary and the 2.4 m, 5000-plus-actuator M4 of the ELT as templates: derive deformable-mirror and wavefront-sensor specifications from r0, the Greenwood frequency and the isoplanatic angle, assemble fitting, temporal, measurement and non-common-path terms into a Strehl budget, and close with real-time control dynamics and on-sky validation for engineering handoff.
procedure: 大氣折射率的隨機起伏由溫度微差造成，其結構遵循 Kolmogorov 統計，強度以 C_n²(h) 剖面描述。沿視線積分後得到 Fried 參數 r0 = [0.423·k²·secζ·∫C_n²(h)dh]^(−3/5)，它是波前相位變異量達到 1 rad² 的孔徑直徑：直徑大於 r0 的望遠鏡，長曝光影像不再隨口徑變銳，而被視寧度 FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r0 限制。因為 k = 2π/λ，r0 ∝ λ^(6/5)，所以同一片大氣在紅外線顯得平靜得多，這是近紅外成為自適應光學主戰場的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「大氣湍流與 Fried 參數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

湍流層被風以速度 v 吹過孔徑，相位圖樣以 Taylor 凍結流假設平移，波前的特徵頻率是 Greenwood 頻率 f_G = 0.427·v/r0；若控制迴路的 −3 dB 頻寬是 f_3dB，殘餘的時間誤差為 σ_t² = (f_G/f_3dB)^(5/3)。另一個限制是角度：相隔 θ 的兩條視線穿過不同的湍流，殘差 σ_a² = (θ/θ0)^(5/3)，等暈角 θ0 = 0.314·r0/h̄ 由湍流的加權平均高度 h̄ 決定。這兩個量分別規定了波前感測器的幀率與參考星必須離目標多近，也直接引出雷射導星與多共軛 AO 的需求。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Greenwood 頻率與等暈角」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

變形鏡以一片薄殼承載連續反射面，由音圈致動器以電容感測閉迴路定位：VLT 的變形副鏡在約 1.1 m 的薄殼上有 1170 個致動器，ELT 的 M4 則是 2.4 m 平面鏡、六片 1.95 mm 厚的玻璃陶瓷薄殼、5000 餘個音圈致動器，每秒更新 1000 次、行程 ±50 µm。致動器投影到主鏡的間距 d 決定可校正的最高空間頻率，殘餘的擬合誤差 σ_fit² ≈ 0.28·(d/r0)^(5/3)；致動器總數因此按 (D/d)² 隨口徑平方成長，行程則必須涵蓋湍流的峰谷值加上望遠鏡自身的像差與風擾。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「變形副鏡與 ELT M4」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Shack–Hartmann 感測器用微透鏡陣列把瞳面切成子孔徑，每個子孔徑的光點位移正比於該處的波前斜率；金字塔感測器則在焦點放一個四面稜鏡，以四個瞳影像的強度差量斜率，對小像差的靈敏度更高。光點位置的量測受光子雜訊限制，每個子孔徑每幀只有數十到數百個光子，所以必須用讀出雜訊低於 1 e⁻ 的 EMCCD 或專用低雜訊紅外偵測器（ELT 的 LISA 由 ESO 與 Teledyne 共同開發）。感測波長的相位誤差換算到科學波段要乘 (λ_s/λ_sci)²。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Shack–Hartmann 與波前感測相機」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

控制器需要知道每個致動器動作時感測器看到什麼：逐一（或以 Hadamard 圖樣）推拉致動器，記錄斜率向量，組成交互矩陣 D；以奇異值分解取偽逆得到控制矩陣，並截去奇異值過小、雜訊放大過大的模態。感測器與科學相機之間的光路不同，科學焦點上存在感測器看不見的非共光路像差（NCPA），必須用相位分集或 PSF 最佳化在科學相機上量出，再轉成感測器的參考斜率偏置。模態基底（Karhunen–Loève）讓每個模態可以有不同的增益。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「交互矩陣與非共光路校正」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

AO 的效能用 Strehl 比衡量：在小像差下 S ≈ exp(−σ²)，σ² 是所有殘餘相位變異的總和（以 rad² 計），各項彼此獨立時直接相加。主要項目是擬合、時間延遲、量測雜訊、混疊（感測器對高頻的錯誤取樣，約為擬合項的三成）、非等暈、NCPA 與色散；影像抖動（tip-tilt 與振動）不屬於小像差，另以 S_j = 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ_j/(λ/D))²] 的因子乘上。預算表讓工程師知道哪一項值得花錢，也決定哪種視寧度下系統值得開迴路。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Strehl 預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

即時控制器每幀讀取相機、算出斜率、以控制矩陣做一次矩陣向量乘法得到致動器指令，再加上積分器；整個路徑的延遲包含曝光、讀出、計算與致動器響應。積分控制的開迴路交越頻率約為 g·f_s/(2π)，但純延遲 τ_d 在交越頻率處造成 360°·f·τ_d 的相位落後，疊加積分器的 90°，相位裕度隨增益上升而消失，所以迴路頻寬受延遲而非運算能力限制。ESO 的 SPARTA 平台與 ELT 的即時控制在 500–1000 Hz 下運作，ELT 的 M4 指令每秒 1000 次。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「即時控制器與迴路延遲」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

系統在天上的驗證包含：對不同星等與離軸角的參考星閉迴路，量 Strehl、FWHM 與包圍能量；同步記錄感測器與變形鏡遙測，重建殘餘相位的功率譜並反推 PSF；在一系列視寧度與相干時間下建立效能對台址條件的統計。交接文件必須給出操作限制（例如 τ0 下限、視寧度上限、星等範圍）、校正檔的版本（交互矩陣、NCPA 偏置、參考斜率）、振動與延遲的量測值，以及每次重新校正的觸發條件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「天上驗證與遙測紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Random refractive-index fluctuations of the air arise from small temperature differences and follow Kolmogorov statistics, with strength described by the C_n²(h) profile. Integrating along the line of sight gives the Fried parameter r0 = [0.423·k²·secζ·∫C_n²(h)dh]^(−3/5), the aperture diameter over which the wavefront phase variance reaches 1 rad²: a telescope larger than r0 gains no further sharpness in long exposures and is limited by the seeing FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r0. Because k = 2π/λ, r0 ∝ λ^(6/5), so the same atmosphere looks far calmer in the infrared, which is why the near-infrared is the main arena of adaptive optics. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Turbulent layers are carried across the aperture by wind at speed v, and under Taylor's frozen-flow hypothesis the phase pattern translates, giving the wavefront a characteristic Greenwood frequency f_G = 0.427·v/r0; with a control −3 dB bandwidth f_3dB, the residual temporal error is σ_t² = (f_G/f_3dB)^(5/3). The other limit is angular: two lines of sight separated by θ cross different turbulence, leaving σ_a² = (θ/θ0)^(5/3) with the isoplanatic angle θ0 = 0.314·r0/h̄ set by the turbulence-weighted mean height h̄. These two quantities fix the wavefront-sensor frame rate and how close the reference star must be, and lead directly to laser guide stars and multi-conjugate AO. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Greenwood frequency and isoplanatic angle”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A deformable mirror carries a continuous reflective facesheet on a thin shell positioned in closed loop by voice-coil actuators with capacitive sensing: the VLT deformable secondary has 1170 actuators behind a shell of about 1.1 m, while the ELT M4 is a 2.4 m flat built from six 1.95 mm glass-ceramic shells with more than 5000 voice coils, updated 1000 times per second with ±50 µm of stroke. The actuator pitch d projected onto the primary sets the highest correctable spatial frequency, leaving a fitting error σ_fit² ≈ 0.28·(d/r0)^(5/3); the actuator count therefore grows as (D/d)², with the square of aperture, and the stroke must cover the turbulence peak-to-valley plus telescope aberrations and wind shake. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Deformable secondary and ELT M4”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A Shack–Hartmann sensor divides the pupil into subapertures with a lenslet array, and the spot displacement in each subaperture is proportional to the local wavefront slope; a pyramid sensor instead places a four-sided prism at the focus and measures slopes from intensity differences between four pupil images, with higher sensitivity to small aberrations. Spot positioning is photon-noise limited, with only tens to hundreds of photons per subaperture per frame, so EMCCDs with sub-electron read noise or dedicated low-noise infrared detectors (the ELT's LISA was co-developed by ESO and Teledyne) are required. Phase error at the sensing wavelength scales to the science band by (λ_s/λ_sci)². Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Shack–Hartmann and wavefront-sensing camera”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The controller must know what the sensor sees when each actuator moves: push–pull each actuator (or Hadamard patterns), record the slope vector and assemble the interaction matrix D; a singular-value decomposition gives the pseudo-inverse control matrix after truncating modes whose small singular values would amplify noise. Because the optical paths to the sensor and to the science camera differ, non-common-path aberrations (NCPA) invisible to the sensor exist at the science focus; they are measured on the science camera by phase diversity or PSF optimisation and converted into reference-slope offsets for the sensor. A modal basis (Karhunen–Loève) allows each mode its own gain. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Interaction matrix and non-common-path calibration”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

AO performance is judged by the Strehl ratio: for small aberrations S ≈ exp(−σ²), where σ² is the sum of all residual phase variances in rad², added directly when the terms are independent. The main terms are fitting, temporal delay, measurement noise, aliasing (the sensor mis-sampling high frequencies, roughly 30% of the fitting term), anisoplanatism, NCPA and chromatic effects; image jitter from tip-tilt and vibration is not a small aberration and is applied as a separate factor S_j = 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ_j/(λ/D))²]. The budget table tells the engineer which term is worth money and under what seeing the loop is worth closing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Strehl budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each frame the real-time controller reads the camera, computes slopes, performs one matrix-vector multiply with the control matrix to obtain actuator commands and applies an integrator; the end-to-end latency includes exposure, readout, computation and actuator response. For integral control the open-loop crossover is about g·f_s/(2π), but a pure delay τ_d adds a phase lag of 360°·f·τ_d at crossover on top of the integrator's 90°, so phase margin vanishes as gain rises and loop bandwidth is limited by latency rather than computing power. ESO's SPARTA platform and the ELT real-time control run at 500–1000 Hz, with M4 commands issued 1000 times per second. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Real-time controller and loop latency”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

On-sky validation closes the loop on reference stars of different magnitudes and off-axis angles, measuring Strehl, FWHM and encircled energy; sensor and deformable-mirror telemetry are recorded synchronously to reconstruct the residual-phase power spectrum and infer the PSF; performance statistics are built against site conditions across a range of seeing and coherence time. The handoff record must state operating limits (such as a τ0 floor, a seeing ceiling and the magnitude range), the versions of calibration files (interaction matrix, NCPA offsets, reference slopes), the measured vibration and latency, and the conditions that trigger recalibration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “On-sky validation and telemetry record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把 r0 當成與波長無關的常數，用可見光的 r0 去設計紅外 AO，會把致動器數與迴路頻率高估數倍；反之用紅外的 r0 設計可見光感測器，則子孔徑太大而讓波前量測失效。
交互矩陣在望遠鏡水平位置量測，而觀測時重力改變了感測器與變形鏡的對位（註冊誤差），矩陣中的致動器與子孔徑錯位半格，迴路雖然收斂卻把能量推到錯誤的模態，Strehl 比預算低且隨高度角變化。
pitfallsEn: Treating r0 as wavelength-independent and designing an infrared AO system with the visible r0 overestimates actuator count and loop rate by several times; using the infrared r0 for a visible-light sensor instead makes the subapertures too large and the wavefront measurement fails.

An interaction matrix measured with the telescope horizontal no longer matches when gravity shifts the registration between sensor and deformable mirror during observation; actuators and subapertures are misaligned by half a cell, the loop converges but pushes energy into wrong modes, and the Strehl falls below budget and varies with elevation.

related.title: 天文雷射導引星
related.transfer: 可遷移「Kolmogorov 湍流、r0 與視寧度」與「交互矩陣、模態控制與 NCPA 校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；天文雷射導引星的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 天文自適應光學
history.text: Horace Babcock 於 1953 年提出以可變形鏡即時補償大氣擾動的構想；1970–80 年代的軍方研究發展出 Shack–Hartmann 感測與變形鏡技術，1991 年解密後進入天文。ESO 在 1989 年於 3.6 m 望遠鏡以 COME-ON 系統首次取得天文 AO 影像，之後 Keck、VLT NACO 相繼投入；2016–2017 年 VLT 的自適應光學設施以 1170 致動器變形副鏡與四雷射導星啟用，ELT 的 2.4 m M4 則把致動器數推到 5000 以上。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Horace Babcock proposed in 1953 that a deformable mirror could compensate atmospheric distortion in real time; military research in the 1970s and 1980s developed Shack–Hartmann sensing and deformable-mirror technology, released to astronomy after declassification in 1991. ESO obtained the first astronomical AO images with the COME-ON system on its 3.6 m telescope in 1989, followed by Keck and VLT NACO; in 2016–2017 the VLT Adaptive Optics Facility entered service with a 1170-actuator deformable secondary and four laser guide stars, and the 2.4 m M4 of the ELT pushes the actuator count beyond 5000. This course reconstructs public physics and engineering logic only.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「Kolmogorov 湍流、r0 與視寧度」到「天上驗證、PSF 重建與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Kolmogorov turbulence, r0 and seeing" through "On-sky validation, PSF reconstruction and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
